<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');
function websitePreviewTheme0(event: CustomEvent<'light' | 'dark'>) {
	dark.value = event.detail === 'dark';
}

import { useExampleText } from './Texts.js';
const text = useExampleText();
import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, provide, reactive, ref } from 'vue';
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router';
import { AsamBaseForm, AsamButton, AsamCheckboxItem, AsamSelect, AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { NavigationShell } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/navigation';
import {
	createSecurity,
	createSecurityNavigation,
	formatSecurityStatus
} from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import { createFixture, identities } from './Fixture.js';
import type { FixtureIdentity } from './Fixture.js';
import { applicationKey } from './Context.js';
import DataPage from './DataPage.vue';
const router = useRouter();
const fixture = createFixture();
fixture.controls = reactive(fixture.controls);
const security = createSecurity({ adapter: fixture.adapter, i18n: text.scope });
const state = security.state;
const identity = ref<FixtureIdentity>('editor');
const dark = ref(false);
const sizes: AsamControlSize[] = ['small', 'default', 'big', 'large'];
const size = ref<AsamControlSize>('default');
const safe = ref<HTMLElement>();
provide(applicationKey, { security, fixture });
const bridge = createSecurityNavigation({
	i18n: text.scope,
	security,
	router,
	components: { workspace: DataPage, audit: DataPage },
	items: [
		{ id: 'workspace', path: '/workspace', title: '工作台', resource: 'workspace' },
		{ id: 'audit', path: '/audit', title: '审计资料', resource: 'audit' }
	],
	rules: {
		'/workspace': { permission: 'workspace:read' },
		'/audit': { role: 'auditor', permission: 'audit:read' }
	},
	publicPaths: ['/safe', '/'],
	safePage: '/safe'
});
const navigation = bridge.navigation;
bridge.resume(router.currentRoute.value.fullPath);
const contextIndex = computed(
	() =>
		state.value.subject?.contexts.findIndex(
			(c) =>
				c.tenant === state.value.subject?.scope.tenant &&
				c.organization === state.value.subject?.scope.organization
		) ?? -1
);
const remove = security.onInvalidate(() => {
	void nextTick(() => safe.value?.focus());
});
async function login() {
	await security.login(identity.value);
}
function expire() {
	bridge.forgetReturn();
	security.expire();
}
async function logout() {
	bridge.forgetReturn();
	await security.logout();
}
async function changeContext(value: unknown) {
	const index = Number(value);
	const context = state.value.subject?.contexts[index];
	if (context) await security.switchContext(context);
}
onMounted(() => security.restore());
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	remove();
	bridge.dispose();
	security.dispose();
});
</script>

import type { createSecurity } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import type { createFixture, FixtureIdentity } from './Fixture.js';

<template>
	<section :aria-label="text.t('data')">
		<p role="status">
			{{ error ? text.t('readFailed') : text.t(loading ? 'loading' : 'ready') }}
		</p>
		<ul>
			<li v-for="row in rows" :key="row">{{ row }}</li>
		</ul>
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<div data-asam-field-caption>{{ text.t('select') }}
			<AsamInput v-model="selected" :aria-label="text.t('select')"  /></div>
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<div data-asam-field-caption>{{ text.t('draft') }}
			<AsamInput v-model="draft" :aria-label="text.t('draft')"  /></div>
		<AsamPermission v-slot="permission" permission="record:write" mode="disable"
			><AsamButton
				:disabled="permission.disabled || writeDenied"
				@click="save"
				type="primary"
				>{{ text.t('save') }}</AsamButton
			></AsamPermission
		><AsamButton @click="load" type="primary">{{ text.t('retry') }}</AsamButton
		><output aria-live="polite">{{ result ? text.t(result) : '' }}</output>
	</section>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useExampleText } from './Texts.js';
const text = useExampleText();
import { computed, inject, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamInput } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamPermission } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { applicationKey } from './Context.js';
const application = inject(applicationKey);
if (!application) throw new Error('Missing application');
const { security, fixture } = application;
const writeDenied = computed(
	() => security.check({ permission: 'record:write', write: true }) !== 'allowed'
);
const rows = ref<string[]>([]);
const draft = ref('');
const selected = ref('');
const result = ref<'denied' | 'saved' | ''>('');
const error = ref(false);
const loading = ref(false);
let generation = 0;
let alive = true;
function clear() {
	generation++;
	rows.value = [];
	draft.value = '';
	selected.value = '';
	result.value = '';
	error.value = false;
	loading.value = false;
}
const remove = security.onInvalidate(clear);
async function load() {
	const subject = security.state.value.subject;
	if (!subject || security.check({ permission: 'workspace:read' }) !== 'allowed') return;
	const token = ++generation;
	const epoch = security.state.value.epoch;
	loading.value = true;
	error.value = false;
	try {
		const value = await fixture.read(subject);
		if (alive && token === generation && epoch === security.state.value.epoch)
			rows.value = value;
	} catch {
		if (alive && token === generation && epoch === security.state.value.epoch)
			error.value = true;
	} finally {
		if (alive && token === generation) loading.value = false;
	}
}
function save() {
	// UI visibility is insufficient; check immediately before calling the host write adapter.
	if (security.check({ permission: 'record:write', write: true }) !== 'allowed') {
		result.value = 'denied';
		return;
	}
	result.value = 'saved';
}
onMounted(load);
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	alive = false;
	clear();
	remove();
});
</script>
ts
import type {
	SecurityAdapter,
	SecurityContext,
	SecuritySubject
} from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';

/** Local demonstration only. Replace this entire adapter with your existing host backend. */
export const contexts: SecurityContext[] = [
	{ tenant: 0, organization: null, label: '总部 / 全部组织' },
	{ tenant: 'east', organization: 0, label: '华东 / 零号组织' },
	{ tenant: 'east', organization: 'sales', label: '华东 / 销售' }
];
export const identities = {
	editor: { name: '林编辑', roles: ['editor'], permissions: ['workspace:read', 'record:write'] },
	auditor: { name: '周审计', roles: ['auditor'], permissions: ['workspace:read', 'audit:read'] },
	readonly: {
		name: '只读访客',
		roles: ['editor'],
		permissions: ['workspace:read', 'record:write']
	},
	empty: { name: '未授权访客', roles: [], permissions: [] }
};
export type FixtureIdentity = keyof typeof identities;
export function createFixture() {
	let remembered: SecuritySubject | null = null;
	const controls = { fail: false, readFail: false, delay: 40 };
	async function wait() {
		await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, controls.delay));
	}
	function subject(identity: FixtureIdentity): SecuritySubject {
		return {
			id: identity,
			...identities[identity],
			scope: contexts[0]!,
			contexts,
			expiresAt: Date.now() + 120000,
			readOnly: identity === 'readonly'
		};
	}
	const adapter: SecurityAdapter<FixtureIdentity> = {
		async login(identity, request) {
			await wait();
			if (controls.fail) throw new Error('fixture login');
			const value = subject(identity);
			if (request.isCurrent()) remembered = value;
			return value;
		},
		async restore() {
			await wait();
			if (controls.fail) throw new Error('fixture restore');
			return remembered;
		},
		async refresh(current, request) {
			await wait();
			if (controls.fail) throw new Error('fixture refresh');
			const value = { ...current, expiresAt: Date.now() + 120000 };
			if (request.isCurrent()) remembered = value;
			return value;
		},
		async switchContext(current, scope, request) {
			await wait();
			if (controls.fail) throw new Error('fixture context');
			const value = { ...current, scope, expiresAt: Date.now() + 120000 };
			if (request.isCurrent()) remembered = value;
			return value;
		},
		async logout(request) {
			if (request.isCurrent()) remembered = null;
			await wait();
			if (controls.fail) throw new Error('fixture logout');
		}
	};
	return {
		adapter,
		controls,
		async read(current: SecuritySubject) {
			await wait();
			if (controls.readFail) throw new Error('fixture data');
			return [
				`${current.name} / ${String(current.scope.tenant)} / ${String(current.scope.organization)} 的资料`
			];
		}
	};
}

import { createApp as createOwnerApp } from 'vue';
import { AsamI18nKey } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createApp, defineComponent, h } from 'vue';
import { createRouter, createMemoryHistory as createWebHistory } from 'vue-router';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
import App from './App.vue';
import { useExampleText } from './Texts.js';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(
	element: Element,
	onError: (error: unknown) => void,
	i18n?: AsamI18n
) {
	const apps: ReturnType<typeof createOwnerApp>[] = [];
	const createApp: typeof createOwnerApp = (...args) => {
		const app = createOwnerApp(...args);
		if (i18n) app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
		app.config.errorHandler = onError;
		apps.push(app);
		return app;
	};

	const router = createRouter({
		history: createWebHistory(),
		routes: [
			{
				path: '/safe',
				component: defineComponent(() => {
					const text = useExampleText();
					return () => h('p', text.t('safeTitle'));
				})
			},
			{
				path: '/:pathMatch(.*)*',
				component: defineComponent(() => {
					const text = useExampleText();
					return () => h('p', text.t('choose'));
				})
			}
		]
	});
	const application = createApp(App).use(router);
	await router.isReady();
	application.mount(element);

	return () => {
		for (const app of apps.reverse()) app.unmount();
	};
}

ts
import { createApp } from 'vue';
import type { App, Component } from 'vue';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
import * as entry from './src/inline-entry';
const demo: {
	default: Component;
	scoped?: boolean;
	configure?: (app: App) => void | (() => void) | Promise<void | (() => void)>;
} = entry;
const app = createApp(
	demo.default,
	demo.scoped ? { scopeId: 'application/security:demo-application-security' } : undefined
);
const cleanup = await demo.configure?.(app);
if (typeof cleanup === 'function') app.onUnmount(cleanup);
app.mount('#app');
window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => app.unmount(), { once: true });

md
# security完整示例

使用Node22.19+的22.x及pnpm11.9.0。在解压目录执行pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、pnpm run typecheck、pnpm run dev、pnpm run build。vendor内正常UI/Pro包与锁文件配套；无源码alias或借入node_modules。

src/MinimalExample.vue展示本能力最小用法；完整场景保留原路由、provider及本地fixture。src/mount.ts与根main.ts已经接好启动和释放，不需要手写网站宿主。预览设置检测不到网站侧栏时在原位置显示。会话、请求均为本地合成，不连接真实业务后端。跨能力通过公开Pro叶子入口引用，导航的Vue Router是必要依赖，其他样式/按钮与fixture属于演示宿主。

Tiptap既有传递依赖可能出现peer告警，未通过修改依赖版本掩盖。

本工程默认运行与文档页内相同的最小示例，入口见src/inline-entry.ts。完整App及作者宿主仍保留在src目录中，可按其依赖单独接入。场景源码ZIP保留同名相对路径，正常包仅位于完整工程vendor目录。
md
# 第三方能力来源

Pro 应用组合式能力通过正式依赖 `@vant/use@1.6.0` 的公开入口复用实现，不依赖 Vant UI 或其样式。

上游：[Vant Use](https://github.com/youzan/vant/tree/main/packages/vant-use)。许可证：MIT。版权：Youzan、Chen Jiahan and other contributors。上游包自身包含其发布声明；安装后的第三方代码仍受其许可证约束。

ASAM 增量为分类/能力出口、自动导入映射、示例及 `AsamCustomField` 表单桥接。`flattenVNodes`、`sortChildren`、`supportsPassive` 不属于 Pro 公开 API，不提供自动导入。上游内部使用自己的辅助函数不构成 ASAM 新增出口。

`useEventListener` 在非浏览器时补齐可调用的停止函数；`useChildren` 在父组件更新时调用上游现有排序函数，同步已关联实例的索引。这两处是薄适配，不复制或改写上游监听/排序算法。父子关联使用上游同样的 Vue 实例协议，按项目锁定的 Vue 版本验证。

const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');
function websitePreviewTheme0(event) {
	dark.value = event.detail === 'dark';
}
import { useExampleText } from './Texts.js';
const text = useExampleText();
import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, provide, reactive, ref } from 'vue';
import { useRouter } from 'vue-router';
import { AsamBaseForm, AsamButton, AsamCheckboxItem, AsamSelect, AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { NavigationShell } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/navigation';
import {
	createSecurity,
	createSecurityNavigation,
	formatSecurityStatus
} from '@asam-ui/pro/application/security';
import { createFixture, identities } from './Fixture.js';
import { applicationKey } from './Context.js';
import DataPage from './DataPage.vue';
const router = useRouter();
const fixture = createFixture();
fixture.controls = reactive(fixture.controls);
const security = createSecurity({ adapter: fixture.adapter, i18n: text.scope });
const state = security.state;
const identity = ref('editor');
const dark = ref(false);
const sizes = ['small', 'default', 'big', 'large'];
const size = ref('default');
const safe = ref();
provide(applicationKey, { security, fixture });
const bridge = createSecurityNavigation({
	i18n: text.scope,
	security,
	router,
	components: { workspace: DataPage, audit: DataPage },
	items: [
		{ id: 'workspace', path: '/workspace', title: '工作台', resource: 'workspace' },
		{ id: 'audit', path: '/audit', title: '审计资料', resource: 'audit' }
	],
	rules: {
		'/workspace': { permission: 'workspace:read' },
		'/audit': { role: 'auditor', permission: 'audit:read' }
	},
	publicPaths: ['/safe', '/'],
	safePage: '/safe'
});
const navigation = bridge.navigation;
bridge.resume(router.currentRoute.value.fullPath);
const contextIndex = computed(
	() =>
		state.value.subject?.contexts.findIndex(
			(c) =>
				c.tenant === state.value.subject?.scope.tenant &&
				c.organization === state.value.subject?.scope.organization
		) ?? -1
);
const remove = security.onInvalidate(() => {
	void nextTick(() => safe.value?.focus());
});
async function login() {
	await security.login(identity.value);
}
function expire() {
	bridge.forgetReturn();
	security.expire();
}
async function logout() {
	bridge.forgetReturn();
	await security.logout();
}
async function changeContext(value) {
	const index = Number(value);
	const context = state.value.subject?.contexts[index];
	if (context) await security.switchContext(context);
}
onMounted(() => security.restore());
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	remove();
	bridge.dispose();
	security.dispose();
});

			><AsamButton
				:disabled="permission.disabled || writeDenied"
				@click="save"
				type="primary"
				>{{ text.t('save') }}</AsamButton
			></AsamPermission
		><AsamButton @click="load" type="primary">{{ text.t('retry') }}</AsamButton

<script setup>
import { useExampleText } from './Texts.js';
const text = useExampleText();
import { computed, inject, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamInput } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamPermission } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { applicationKey } from './Context.js';
const application = inject(applicationKey);
if (!application) throw new Error('Missing application');
const { security, fixture } = application;
const writeDenied = computed(
	() => security.check({ permission: 'record:write', write: true }) !== 'allowed'
);
const rows = ref([]);
const draft = ref('');
const selected = ref('');
const result = ref('');
const error = ref(false);
const loading = ref(false);
let generation = 0;
let alive = true;
function clear() {
	generation++;
	rows.value = [];
	draft.value = '';
	selected.value = '';
	result.value = '';
	error.value = false;
	loading.value = false;
}
const remove = security.onInvalidate(clear);
async function load() {
	const subject = security.state.value.subject;
	if (!subject || security.check({ permission: 'workspace:read' }) !== 'allowed') return;
	const token = ++generation;
	const epoch = security.state.value.epoch;
	loading.value = true;
	error.value = false;
	try {
		const value = await fixture.read(subject);
		if (alive && token === generation && epoch === security.state.value.epoch)
			rows.value = value;
	} catch {
		if (alive && token === generation && epoch === security.state.value.epoch)
			error.value = true;
	} finally {
		if (alive && token === generation) loading.value = false;
	}
}
function save() {
	// UI visibility is insufficient; check immediately before calling the host write adapter.
	if (security.check({ permission: 'record:write', write: true }) !== 'allowed') {
		result.value = 'denied';
		return;
	}
	result.value = 'saved';
}
onMounted(load);
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	alive = false;
	clear();
	remove();
});
</script>

/** Local demonstration only. Replace this entire adapter with your existing host backend. */
export const contexts = [
	{ tenant: 0, organization: null, label: '总部 / 全部组织' },
	{ tenant: 'east', organization: 0, label: '华东 / 零号组织' },
	{ tenant: 'east', organization: 'sales', label: '华东 / 销售' }
];
export const identities = {
	editor: { name: '林编辑', roles: ['editor'], permissions: ['workspace:read', 'record:write'] },
	auditor: { name: '周审计', roles: ['auditor'], permissions: ['workspace:read', 'audit:read'] },
	readonly: {
		name: '只读访客',
		roles: ['editor'],
		permissions: ['workspace:read', 'record:write']
	},
	empty: { name: '未授权访客', roles: [], permissions: [] }
};
export function createFixture() {
	let remembered = null;
	const controls = { fail: false, readFail: false, delay: 40 };
	async function wait() {
		await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, controls.delay));
	}
	function subject(identity) {
		return {
			id: identity,
			...identities[identity],
			scope: contexts[0],
			contexts,
			expiresAt: Date.now() + 120000,
			readOnly: identity === 'readonly'
		};
	}
	const adapter = {
		async login(identity, request) {
			await wait();
			if (controls.fail) throw new Error('fixture login');
			const value = subject(identity);
			if (request.isCurrent()) remembered = value;
			return value;
		},
		async restore() {
			await wait();
			if (controls.fail) throw new Error('fixture restore');
			return remembered;
		},
		async refresh(current, request) {
			await wait();
			if (controls.fail) throw new Error('fixture refresh');
			const value = { ...current, expiresAt: Date.now() + 120000 };
			if (request.isCurrent()) remembered = value;
			return value;
		},
		async switchContext(current, scope, request) {
			await wait();
			if (controls.fail) throw new Error('fixture context');
			const value = { ...current, scope, expiresAt: Date.now() + 120000 };
			if (request.isCurrent()) remembered = value;
			return value;
		},
		async logout(request) {
			if (request.isCurrent()) remembered = null;
			await wait();
			if (controls.fail) throw new Error('fixture logout');
		}
	};
	return {
		adapter,
		controls,
		async read(current) {
			await wait();
			if (controls.readFail) throw new Error('fixture data');
			return [
				`${current.name} / ${String(current.scope.tenant)} / ${String(current.scope.organization)} 的资料`
			];
		}
	};
}

import { createApp as createOwnerApp } from 'vue';
import { AsamI18nKey } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createApp, defineComponent, h } from 'vue';
import { createRouter, createMemoryHistory as createWebHistory } from 'vue-router';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
import App from './App.vue';
import { useExampleText } from './Texts.js';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(element, onError, i18n) {
	const apps = [];
	const createApp = (...args) => {
		const app = createOwnerApp(...args);
		if (i18n) app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
		app.config.errorHandler = onError;
		apps.push(app);
		return app;
	};
	const router = createRouter({
		history: createWebHistory(),
		routes: [
			{
				path: '/safe',
				component: defineComponent(() => {
					const text = useExampleText();
					return () => h('p', text.t('safeTitle'));
				})
			},
			{
				path: '/:pathMatch(.*)*',
				component: defineComponent(() => {
					const text = useExampleText();
					return () => h('p', text.t('choose'));
				})
			}
		]
	});
	const application = createApp(App).use(router);
	await router.isReady();
	application.mount(element);
	return () => {
		for (const app of apps.reverse()) app.unmount();
	};
}

import { createApp } from 'vue';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
import * as entry from './src/inline-entry';
const demo = entry;
const app = createApp(
	demo.default,
	demo.scoped ? { scopeId: 'application/security:demo-application-security' } : undefined
);
const cleanup = await demo.configure?.(app);
if (typeof cleanup === 'function') app.onUnmount(cleanup);
app.mount('#app');
window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => app.unmount(), { once: true });

md
# security完整示例

使用Node22.19+的22.x及pnpm11.9.0。在解压目录执行pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、pnpm run typecheck、pnpm run dev、pnpm run build。vendor内正常UI/Pro包与锁文件配套；无源码alias或借入node_modules。

src/MinimalExample.vue展示本能力最小用法；完整场景保留原路由、provider及本地fixture。src/mount.ts与根main.ts已经接好启动和释放，不需要手写网站宿主。预览设置检测不到网站侧栏时在原位置显示。会话、请求均为本地合成，不连接真实业务后端。跨能力通过公开Pro叶子入口引用，导航的Vue Router是必要依赖，其他样式/按钮与fixture属于演示宿主。

Tiptap既有传递依赖可能出现peer告警，未通过修改依赖版本掩盖。

本工程默认运行与文档页内相同的最小示例，入口见src/inline-entry.js。完整App及作者宿主仍保留在src目录中，可按其依赖单独接入。场景源码ZIP保留同名相对路径，正常包仅位于完整工程vendor目录。
md
# 第三方能力来源

Pro 应用组合式能力通过正式依赖 `@vant/use@1.6.0` 的公开入口复用实现，不依赖 Vant UI 或其样式。

上游：[Vant Use](https://github.com/youzan/vant/tree/main/packages/vant-use)。许可证：MIT。版权：Youzan、Chen Jiahan and other contributors。上游包自身包含其发布声明；安装后的第三方代码仍受其许可证约束。

ASAM 增量为分类/能力出口、自动导入映射、示例及 `AsamCustomField` 表单桥接。`flattenVNodes`、`sortChildren`、`supportsPassive` 不属于 Pro 公开 API，不提供自动导入。上游内部使用自己的辅助函数不构成 ASAM 新增出口。

`useEventListener` 在非浏览器时补齐可调用的停止函数；`useChildren` 在父组件更新时调用上游现有排序函数，同步已关联实例的索引。这两处是薄适配，不复制或改写上游监听/排序算法。父子关联使用上游同样的 Vue 实例协议，按项目锁定的 Vue 版本验证。

完整可运行工程

源码面板保留最小用法、作者完整示例和工程配置；完整工程 ZIP 另含正常包 vendor、锁文件与所需补丁。解压后运行pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、pnpm run typecheck和pnpm run dev，默认运行同一份页内示例。完整独立预览展示组合应用。示例使用本地合成数据，真实会话、菜单与业务传输由消费应用注入。

接口、行为与迁移细节

接口与行为

Types.ts 是类型权威，Security.ts/Navigation.ts 与此文同版。

接口 契约
SecurityId 非空字符串或有限数字；严格区分0和'0'
SecurityScope tenant/organization分别为SecurityId或null，不把空字符串当null
SecuritySubject id/name/roles/permissions/scope/contexts/expiresAt/readOnly；只含展示安全字段；expiresAt为毫秒时间戳
SecurityAdapter login(C,request)、restore(request)、refresh(subject,request)、switchContext(subject,scope,request)、logout(request)，异步宿主边界
SecurityRequest signal + isCurrent()；宿主在实际凭据/存储提交前也核当前代次
createSecurity({adapter,now?}) 独立控制器；now默认Date.now，可注入测试时钟
state 深只读ref，status/subject/error/epoch；没有原异常、凭据或原DTO
login/restore/refresh/switchContext/logout Promise；旧代次、失败或匿名为false，成功认证/登出为true
check({permission?,role?,write?}) allowed/denied/pending/error；permission与role为AND；至少一个明确非空条件，write额外检查readOnly
permission(code) 应用配置 provider同步check桥，禁止用菜单可见性替代路由鉴权
expire/reset 同步撤销旧会话和读取；分别expired/anonymous；无远端副作用
onInvalidate(listener) 同步清理边界，返回取消订阅函数；允许同步login/reset/logout重入，后发操作取代旧操作；异常关闭本次操作并继续当前代次其余清理，不回显异常正文
dispose 幂等废弃全部旧结果、计时器、订阅；终态disposed
scopeKey(subject) JSON数组编码用户/租户/组织的类型化身份，无字符串分隔符碰撞
safeReturnPath(input,fallback?) 只接收规范应用内绝对路径；拒绝外部、反斜线、控制字符、路径编码及dot规范化；fallback默认/safe，宿主只传可信fallback
createSecurityNavigation security/router/components/items/rules/publicPaths/safePage；每个非公开path明确规则；只支持这里声明的精确路径，参数路由由宿主先转成明确策略再接入
navigation shallowRef，认证成功生成的新导航模板实例或null；模板以epoch为key，不能复用旧页缓存
resume(path)/forgetReturn 设置已过滤的登录后位置/忘记位置；登出和失效前forgetReturn
dispose桥 取消guard/watch/订阅并dispose其拥有导航；宿主router不销毁

状态：anonymous → restoring/authenticating → authenticated；authenticated → refreshing/switching → authenticated；任意操作失败→error，过期→expired，登出→logging-out→anonymous/error。所有开始操作都先清subject和增加epoch。刷新结果必须同主体/同scope，切换结果必须同主体/指定scope。新恢复/登录、reset、logout、expire、dispose废弃旧成功和失败。刷新时禁用受限交互，成功后以新权限重建导航。

examples组件不是包级API。App负责组装/焦点/真实history，DataPage负责自己的范围数据和草稿。宿主提供凭据输入时只短暂传给adapter，不存入展示状态；当前fixture用身份枚举演示而无密码。错误后可以明确登录或恢复，远端登出失败仍保持本地清空。

使用说明

从@asam-ui/pro/application/security导入createSecurity, createSecurityNavigation；主包Application.security共享同一实现。类型使用同路径import type。通过宿主adapter管理登录、恢复、刷新、上下文切换与登出。适配器接入真实会话，前端权限不替代后端授权；控制器不持久保存业务凭据。 最小与完整示例、逐文件复制下载及完整工程ZIP见本页示例区。

examples/main.ts 与 App.vue 是正常应用入口，使用公开 @asam-ui/ui、@asam-ui/pro 和同版可修改导航源码，无源码 alias 或手补声明。生产服务器应将应用内 history 路由回退到 index.html。本地示例 无跨刷新持久化，刷新页面后回到匿名；真实恢复行为由宿主已有会话适配器决定。本页提供完整运行示例和源码。

宿主实现 SecurityAdapter：登录、恢复、刷新、登出、上下文切换返回经过归一化的展示主体。宿主拥有 HTTP client、Cookie/token、实际存储、后端 URL/DTO、组织租户列表和最终鉴权。模板不猜 CL 接口，不提供 OAuth 或后端租户管理平台。不要把原始响应、密码、token放进 SecuritySubject、错误消息、DOM、日志或 URL。控制器只复制明确字段；异常使用固定本地消息。宿主凭据提交也必须检查 request.isCurrent()；取消信号只是辅助，不能使忽略取消的外部写入变得安全。远端登出与后继登录若并发，需要宿主按会话标识隔离远端操作。

每次恢复/登录/刷新/上下文切换先关闭权限并触发同步 onInvalidate。宿主在此清除独立数据读取、选择、详情和敏感草稿。导航桥销毁旧导航（路由、页签和缓存）并转公开安全页，认证成功才创建新实例。不要用旧导航的 reload(scope) 代替身份隔离，不得在身份改变后用 dirty 确认保留旧页面。若要取消切换，应在调用 switchContext 之前确认。DataPage 示范读取的本地代次、控制器 epoch 与卸载检查，旧读取即使忽略 AbortSignal 也不会写回。

权限必须明确、同步，分别检查 role 和 permission，不推导超级管理员或通配符。入口 visible 只影响菜单；真实 router guard 独立检查，调用业务写入前再次检查 write/readOnly。后端最终拒绝仍须正常处理。非 authenticated、过期、空/错误权限都关闭受限操作。刷新不自动重发业务写入，不循环刷新；并发只合并同代次刷新。失败后主体清空，可明确重试登录/恢复；没有保留凭据用于自动重试。

App 的身份选择用于本地演示，不能作为生产身份来源。替换 Fixture.ts 为实际后端 adapter，再按真实资源配置 rules/items/components/publicPaths。所有 protected path 必须有规则，未知路径回安全页。安全页必须在 publicPaths 中。普通示例明确区分数值0、字符串'0'和null，作用域键使用JSON数组避免拼接碰撞。多个应用/SSR请求各建实例，卸载同时 dispose桥及控制器。

已有项目迁移：将认证状态从全局UI配置移到应用实例；将旧菜单可见性规则补到router guard及写调用前检查；为数据读取补epoch/销毁检查；在上下文切换前拆除旧缓存。此模板没有修改已有包契约，不要求迁移其他组件。尚未验证真实CL/真实后端、其他浏览器、OS读屏及完整SSR hydration。

同步重入：每次操作在通知之前独立绑定token与AbortController，abort、状态watch或onInvalidate回调发起的新操作使旧操作立即失效。旧操作返回后不再通知旧代次的后续监听器、不调用尚未开始的adapter、不更新新状态或timer。刷新合并槽也在通知前绑定请求所有权；旧操作结算不能清新槽。同代监听器内再次refresh仍复用同一promise，新身份则发新adapter调用。清理监听器抛错时继续当前代次其余清理并进入固定错误状态，明确重试；抛错前已重入新代次时不覆盖新代次。dispose先进入终态，所有同步回调均不能重新登录。宿主仍负责凭据提交检查和最终后端鉴权。

语言接入与迁移

createSecurity({ adapter, i18n }) 接受当前应用或 SSR 请求显式提供的作用域；组件通过 AsamApplicationProvider 的 config.base.i18n 使用同一语言源。语言变化只更新本能力自有反馈，不重新认证，不切换主体或上下文，也不清除表单草稿。未传 i18n 的旧项目保留历史行为。

服务端业务文本、组织名称和原始异常仍由宿主负责，不当作组件资源 key。展示错误时按语言与区域的组件外消息契约解析；诊断码与对象身份保持，不覆盖原始 message。卸载应用时按原生命周期释放控制器及由该应用拥有的作用域；本能力不接管第三方业务翻译框架。

完整类型

Types.ts · 完整类型
ts
export type SecurityId = string | number;
export type SecurityErrorCode = 'cleanup' | 'authentication' | 'logout';
export interface SecurityScope {
	tenant: SecurityId | null;
	organization: SecurityId | null;
}
export interface SecurityContext extends SecurityScope {
	label: string;
}
/** Display-safe normalized backend result. Never include credentials or raw DTOs. */
export interface SecuritySubject {
	id: SecurityId;
	name: string;
	roles: readonly string[];
	permissions: readonly string[];
	scope: SecurityScope;
	contexts: readonly SecurityContext[];
	expiresAt: number;
	readOnly?: boolean;
}
export interface SecurityRequest {
	signal: AbortSignal;
	/** False immediately after supersession, including synchronous abort/state/listener reentry.
	 * Host must also use this before committing credential/storage side effects. */
	isCurrent: () => boolean;
}
export interface SecurityAdapter<Credentials> {
	login: (credentials: Credentials, request: SecurityRequest) => Promise<SecuritySubject>;
	restore: (request: SecurityRequest) => Promise<SecuritySubject | null>;
	refresh: (subject: SecuritySubject, request: SecurityRequest) => Promise<SecuritySubject>;
	switchContext: (
		subject: SecuritySubject,
		scope: SecurityScope,
		request: SecurityRequest
	) => Promise<SecuritySubject>;
	logout: (request: SecurityRequest) => Promise<void>;
}
export type SecurityStatus =
	| 'anonymous'
	| 'restoring'
	| 'authenticating'
	| 'refreshing'
	| 'switching'
	| 'authenticated'
	| 'expired'
	| 'error'
	| 'logging-out'
	| 'disposed';
export interface SecurityState {
	status: SecurityStatus;
	subject: SecuritySubject | null;
	/** Fixed local message, never the adapter's exception text. */
	error: string;
	/** Original local diagnostic is separate from the scope-bound display getter. */
	errorDiagnostic?: string;
	errorCode?: SecurityErrorCode;
	epoch: number;
}
export interface SecurityRule {
	permission?: string;
	role?: string;
	write?: boolean;
}
